title: Malicious code in the_shaolin_workout_by_shi_yan_ming_r43vx (npm)
description: The npm package 'the_shaolin_workout_by_shi_yan_ming_r43vx' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. It is strongly advised to remove the package and immediately rotate all secrets and keys from a different, uncompromised machine. Due to the nature of the compromise, removing the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software introduced.
